Security review completed and written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-120000-feature-new-drawing-pages/security_review.md`.

### Key Findings
1. **Medium — Unvalidated remote `pages` in collaboration (`excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx:833`, `excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts:125`)**: `remotePages` from WebSocket payloads and `parsed.pages` from Firebase are applied directly to `AppState` via `updateScene` without schema/type normalization, allowing malformed payloads to break rendering for collaborators.
2. **Low — Prototype property lookup on `pageViewports` (`packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts:1352`, `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx:2804`, `excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx:853`)**: Indexing `pageViewports[pageId]` without `Object.hasOwn` / prototype-key filtering allows reserved keys (`__proto__`, `constructor`, `toString`) to resolve to `Object.prototype` and corrupt viewport state.
